name: MCL Profit-Memory Product Re-entry Census
hypothesis: After V18 has causally banked a failed-auction profit-memory exit, the first same-direction two-hour refinery-crack transition within the same Globex session and before the next raw CL turn may be a distinct financing event that lawfully re-arms one position without changing V18 direction discovery.
source_exit: V18 basis_breadth failed-auction position closed causally by profit_memory; no PnL value or later path may affect eligibility

candidate_law.clock: strictly after the profit-memory exit and strictly before the next raw V18 CL turn
candidate_law.session: same Globex trading session as the exit
candidate_law.product_event: first crack_120m trigger whose direction matches the exited position
candidate_law.identity: same dated MCL suffix at exit, trigger, and projected next-minute entry
candidate_law.entry_readiness: the projected next one-minute MCL open must exist and lie outside the 16:25–18:00 ET admission blackout
candidate_law.multiplicity: at most one candidate per profit-memory exit/raw-turn epoch
candidate_law.direction_authority: unchanged V18 direction; product state may only re-arm it

if_eligible: Freeze one exact re-entry lifecycle and costs before reading any candidate forward PnL. The census may not select a hold time, stop, target, threshold, or direction profile.
if_ineligible: Reject product-complex profit-memory re-entry before outcomes; do not widen clocks, cross sessions, ignore raw turns, or lower cohort floors.
